This looks like a CBP ruling on a collision-warning system treated as a functional unit under Section XVI Note 4. The system has a camera, a processing unit, a radio receiver and a transmitter. Its principal function is detecting hazards and transmitting a warning, which points to heading 8531 (electric sound or visual signaling apparatus) or heading 8526 (radar and radio remote control apparatus).

Heading 8531 covers burglar or fire alarms and similar apparatus. Subheading 8531.80 covers other apparatus, and 8531.80.90 is the other-apparatus line. Another candidate is 8531.10, burglar or fire alarms and similar apparatus, which includes 8531.10.00 with a 10-digit statistical suffix such as 8531.10.0045 for other.

The system detects approaching vehicles and alerts workers. That is a warning or alarm function, but it is not a burglar or fire alarm. I think 8531.10 "similar apparatus" is plausible, since it covers detection-based alarm systems. However, the system is better described as an "other" electric signaling apparatus, so 8531.80.90 is the better fit.

I'm going with 8531.80.9085 as the best guess, though I am not certain of the final statistical suffix.
